title: Expanded Move-Over Protection: Change Lanes or Slow Down for ANY Disabled Motorist Displaying Flashing Hazard Lights!

no_head_on_same_lane.note: All visible vehicles (blue sedan foreground left and two distant cars) face away from viewer in same direction; no head-on facing in same lane.

no_rhd_cabin.note: No steering wheel or driver cabin details visible to judge drive side; interior only glimpsed through minivan side window.

single_bulb_signal.note: No traffic signal present in highway scene.

us_right_hand_traffic.note: Blue sedan travels forward with solid yellow line on its RIGHT side between travel lane and shoulder where minivan is stopped; US requires yellow on LEFT and white edge on RIGHT.

zero_text.note: Overhead green gantry signs are blank shapes and license plate is blank white rectangle; no letters, numbers or words visible.

scene_match.note: Shows disabled minivan on right shoulder with flashing amber hazards and woman at door, with blue sedan in left lane giving buffer, matching move-over for disabled motorist; rear hatch open instead of front hood but still conveys disabled vehicle.

result.summary: Move-over action is clear but road marking is wrong with yellow line on right side of travel lane, failing US right-hand traffic.

teaching_correct.note: Move-over buffer and hazard-light cue are taught correctly; minivan fully off travel lane and passing car left giving space.

result.what_i_see: A silver minivan with open rear hatch and glowing amber hazards is stopped on the right shoulder with a woman leaning at its side door, while a blue sedan passes in the lane to its left on a sunny palm-lined highway with blank overhead signs.
